column1: # Data owners (repositories / services) that tools call through methods no read endpoint calls (S6 follow-up, 2026-10-29).
# An owner not listed here keeps the gate of the read endpoints that call its other methods (same repository = same data);
# an owner no read endpoint touches at all must be listed. Pinned by GatedDataToolAiPathPermissionTest.

column5: reason

column1: # kind: GATE = the listed read handlers serve this data in the App and their gate applies to every tool that reads it;
#       OPEN = the listed read handlers serve it ungated; INTERNAL = no business data;
#       NO_APP_PAGE = business data with no App read page, the reason says why it is not sensitive.
